It is resolved by reading the later order directly: EO 8376 (signed 13 March 1940) paragraph 2 revokes EO 2489 by number and names its reserved lands, so the flag adds nothing beyond the primary text read here.

proposed_intervals.note: Single clause (reservation of NE1/4 sec. 21, T. 28 S., R. 8 W., N.M.P.M., New Mexico, 160 acres, for military purposes). End = signing date of the revoking order EO 8376; no separate effective date is stated in its text, and the end is inclusive/exclusive-neutral (a one-day-resolution date). Start is the signing date from the held ProQuest text register.

rationale: No: the whole order was ended by EO 8376. EO 2489 (held ProQuest text) only reserves the NE1/4 of sec. 21, T. 28 S., R. 8 W., N.M.P.M., New Mexico, 160 acres, for military purposes. EO 8376 of 13 March 1940 (held FR original text and APP mirror text) lists, among its lands, T. 28 S., R. 8 W., sec. 21, NE¼, and provides in paragraph 2: Executive Orders No. 2489 of November 21, 1916, and No. 2575 of April 4, 1917, reserving the above-described lands for military purposes, are hereby revoked. Partial scope: the revocation covers the sole reserved tract, so no clause survives. Earlier endings: the held corpus cites EO 2489 by number only in EO 8376 (two copies), so no earlier ending is shown; the order states no term. Savings: EO 8376 has no savings clause for 2489; as a one-tract reservation nothing in 2489 survives except the withdrawal history. The end date is the signing date of EO 8376 (FR publication 16 March 1940 per the cited FR issue); a stated effective date is absent. The held ProQuest scan page of EO 2489 was inspected by the clause_inventory worker (one page, Wilson, 21 Nov 1916) and the APP mirror of EO 8376 was re-read in this pass: it lists T. 28 S., R. 8 W., sec. 21, NE¼ and paragraph 2 revokes Executive Orders No. 2489 of November 21, 1916, and No. 2575 of April 4, 1917; signed March 13, 1940. Status is a proposal for independent review only.
